name: Control DualSense Mod
summary: Adaptive trigger settings for every Service Weapon form.
description:
A mod for Control Ultimate Edition that adds DualSense adaptive trigger settings for all Service Weapon forms. This mod allows players with a Playstation 5 DualSense controller to play Control Ultimate Edition with adaptive triggers. The adaptive triggers are assigned based on the current weapon form.

This mod adds the following features:
- Adaptive Triggers for both L2 and R2 for each weapon form
- Adaptive triggers get disabled when the player is on an inner Menu or the game is paused
